content.short: ScaleBit provides security audits for all blockchains and cross-chain applications.
content.description: ScaleBit is a dedicated blockchain security team focused on creating security solutions that support the mass adoption of Web3. Drawing on deep experience with scaling technologies—including blockchain interoperability and zero-knowledge proofs—ScaleBit conducts thorough, state-of-the-art security audits for blockchain applications. The team consists of security professionals with extensive experience in academia and enterprise, committed to rigorous assessment and practical risk mitigation for developers and organizations building on multiple chains.
